major_rules: Addition or removal of a vital detail

Changes in any value (excluding formatting-only changes such as line breaks,
, spacing, or list closure)
Introduction of new information that significantly modifies the meaning
minor_rules: Word order changes that don't affect the overall meaning
no_change_rules: Any type of formatting changes or formatting adjustments, specially when its table markdown or table structure
In case of tables any type of formatting such as pipe counts, spacing, bold/italic/code ticks, markdown fences, HTML border/align
Formatting changes observed, such as bold text and quotes around values
Capitalization from lower to upper case or upper to lower cases
